headline: The hardware powering OpenAI — not Nvidia
OpenAI bought 10,000+ Macs
body: Reported August 31. Tens of thousands of Apple Silicon machines now train and run ChatGPT.

headline: Apple becomes AI infrastructure
body: Wall Street now treats Apple like Nvidia — essential hardware for the biggest AI company.

headline: Apple sues over stolen secrets
body: Apple alleges a former engineer took chip designs to OpenAI. Lawsuit expanded this week.

headline: Your Mac runs the same chips
body: M-series chips in your laptop share architecture with OpenAI's new server farm.

headline: But Apple keeps control tight
body: You can't rent Mac compute like AWS. Apple decides who gets access.

headline: Honest take: stock wins, users wait
body: Great for Apple shareholders. For everyone else, local AI on Mac improves — but cloud options stay limited.
